results.title: VIDEO: Rodrigo De Paul pays tribute to Lionel Messi after the death of his father Jorge with an emotional celebration at the Leagues Cup
results.description: Rodrigo De Paul produced a moment of magic on the pitch and a touching gesture off it during Inter Miami’s recent Leagues Cup clash against Monterrey. The midfielder used his scoring moment to send a powerful message of support to his close friend and teammate Lionel Messi during a difficult period for the eight-time Ballon d'Or winner.
